sloka: अभिषिक्तौ सुतावङ्के प्रतिष्ठाप्य पुरे ततः ।परिष्वज्य महाबाहुर्मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय चासकृत् ।। ७.१०७.१८ ॥
transliteration: abhiṣiktau sutāvaṅke pratiṣṭhāpya pure tataḥ ।pariṣvajya mahābāhurmūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt ।। 7.107.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, the mighty-armed Rama, having consecrated his two sons and established them in the city, repeatedly embraced them and kissed them on their heads.
